tools.name: request_purchase
tools.title: Ask the owner's purchase gate to buy something
tools.description:
Submit a purchase REQUEST to the owner's capped, ledgered purchase gate. This is the ONLY way to spend money:
never call vendor APIs or checkout pages directly, and never try to approve your own request.

Tiers are set by the vendor's QUOTED total (tax + shipping), not your estimate:
  under $69.00: automatic. The owner is notified first and has a short window to cancel.
  $69.00 to $500.00: the owner must tap Approve on a private link.
  $500.01 to $1000.00: automatic only if the robot fund covers it (with a longer veto window).
  over $1000.00: always refused.
Daily, monthly and per-vendor caps apply; a request that would exceed one is denied.

reach, declared honestly: 'self' = only affects the owner; 'world' = affects the public or shared spaces;
'others' = reaches another person (a gift, something in a housemate's space). 'others' ALWAYS needs the owner's approval.
The vendor can raise reach but you can never lower it.

budget 'joy' = the owner's small weekly surprise budget. Joy must be reach 'self', must land in the automatic tier
(never asks), and is a sealed envelope: never name joy picks in chat. For joy, `reason` is the why-note the owner reads on delivery.

Returns the gate's row: a denial is a normal result with plain-English reasons, not an error.
Every request gets an idempotencyKey (auto-generated if missing); reuse the SAME key only to retry the SAME payload.

vendor.description: Vendor id from the gate's allowlist (e.g. 'mock' in a test gate)

maxUnitCents.description: Refuse if the unit price is above this (cents)

reason.description: Why you want this, honestly and specifically. Shown to the owner. For joy: the why-note delivered with the item.

reach.description: Who this affects. Pick truthfully; 'others' always asks.

maxTotalCents.description: Your ceiling in cents including tax and shipping. The gate refuses to place above it.

budget.description: Default 'general'. 'joy' only for the weekly quiet-joy routine.

taskId.description: What task this is for. Default: a generated id.

tools.name: purchase_status
tools.title: Check one purchase request
tools.description: Get the current state of a request you submitted, with the gate's reasons in plain English. Joy requests stay sealed (items hidden).

tools.name: list_purchases
tools.title: List purchase requests
tools.description: List requests in one state. With no state, lists everything still open (dm_pending, dm_delivered, pending_approval, approved, placing, placed, delivered). Joy requests stay sealed.

state.description: One gate state; omit for all open requests

tools.name: budget
tools.title: Show spending windows and the robot fund
tools.description: Show how much of each spending window (day, month, joy week, per vendor) is used, and the robot fund balance. Check this before requesting so you don't ask for something a cap will deny.

vendor.description: Also show this vendor's monthly cap
